answer: Commit-reveal bond. Each identity locks 70 credits and commits its next job in a karst chamber. It reveals the job with its lotus record, signed proof. Each epoch a random gale replays 5% of chambers; mismatch, missing reveal, or one key in two chambers burns the bond, so rented-commit rings fail: one lotus record matches one commit only. Fakes cost 44+7(k-1) each; 1,000 cost 3,540,500 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 44 once, keep their bonds.
